params.name: Type
params.usage: 0: ADSR; 25: AHR; 50: AR; 75: AR loop; 127: Open

params.name: Attack
params.desc: Sets the time required for the EG to reach its maximum level once a note is played

params.name: Release
params.desc: Sets the time required for the EG to reach 0 once a note has ended

params.name: Mix
params.desc: Sets the dry/wet balance of the effect

params.name: Type
params.usage: 0: Lowpass-2pole; 18: Lowpass-4 pole; 36: Bandpass-2pole; 54: Bandpass-4pole; 72: Highpass-2 pole; 90: Highpass-4pole; 127: Off

params.name: Cutoff
params.desc: Sets the cutoff frequency altering the brightness of the sound

params.name: Resonance
params.desc: Adds emphasis to the overtones occurring at the cutoff frequency

params.name: Sweep Rate
params.desc: Sweep rate: F0.0-F30.0; Sets the cutoff sweep frequency

params.name: Delay type
params.usage: 0: Off; 21: Stereo; 42: MNono; 63: Ping pong; 84: Highpass; 127: Tape

params.name: Reverb type
params.usage: 0: Off; 21: Hall; 42: Plate; 63: Space; 84: Riser; 127: Submarine

params.name: Pattern
params.usage: 0: Up; 12: Down; 24: Up-down; 36: Down-up; 48: Conv; 60: Div; 72: Conv-div; 84: Div-conv; 96: Rand; 127: Stoch

params.name: Intervals
params.usage: 0: Oct; 21: Maj; 42: Sus; 63: Aug; 84: Min; 127: Dim
